invariants.description: lumen water balance: q_gi_W = q_gi_W_init + (v_giIn_W - v_giOut_W) t - integral of v_gi_W (trapezoid on the output grid; tolerance 1e-5 q_gi_W_init plus the trapezoid error bound dt max|v|/10 for the fast initial transient)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_gi_W - q_gi_W_init - (v_giIn_W - v_giOut_W)*t + np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(v_gi_W[1:] + v_gi_W[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 1e-5*q_gi_W_init + 0.1*(t[1] - t[0])*np.max(np.abs(v_gi_W))

invariants.description: lumen + epithelium Na balance: q_gi_Na + q_giEpi_Na = initial + (v_giIn_Na - v_giOut_Na) t - integral of v_giEpi_NKE (Na leaves only through the NKE to the blood; same tolerance form)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_gi_Na + q_giEpi_Na - q_gi_Na_init - q_giEpi_Na_init - (v_giIn_Na - v_giOut_Na)*t + np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(v_giEpi_NKE[1:] + v_giEpi_NKE[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 1e-5*(q_gi_Na_init + q_giEpi_Na_init) + 0.1*(t[1] - t[0])*np.max(np.abs(v_giEpi_NKE))

invariants.description: constitutive relations: c = q/V, C = 1000 c, u_gi_osmotic = RT c_gi_Na, v_gi_W = k_gi_W (RT q_vc_Na/q_vc_W - u_gi_osmotic), v_gi_Na = kK_gi_Na (q_gi_Na - q_giEpi_Na)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(c_gi_Na, q_gi_Na/q_gi_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(c_giEpi_Na, q_giEpi_Na/q_giEpi_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(C_gi_Na, 1000*c_gi_Na, rtol=1e-12) and np.allclose(C_giEpi_Na, 1000*c_giEpi_Na, rtol=1e-12) and np.allclose(u_gi_osmotic, RT*c_gi_Na, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(v_gi_W, k_gi_W*(RT*q_vc_Na/q_vc_W - u_gi_osmotic), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-9*k_gi_W*RT*q_vc_Na/q_vc_W) and np.allclose(v_gi_Na, kK_gi_Na*(q_gi_Na - q_giEpi_Na), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-9*kK_gi_Na*q_gi_Na_init)

invariants.description: NKE flux equals its closed form 3 k (A^3 B^2 - C^3 D^2 exp(2 F u/RT)) / ((1+A^3)(1+C^3)(1+B^2)(1+D^2)), A = K_Na c_giEpi, B = K_K q_vc_K/q_vc_W, C = K_Na q_vc_Na/q_vc_W, D = K_K q_giEpi_K/q_giEpi_W; so its sign is that of the thermodynamic driving force

analytic steady state (balanced in/outflows at the run point): lumen isotonic with blood (c_gi_Na = q_vc_Na/q_vc_W), q_gi_Na = q_giEpi_Na, and NKE at equilibrium c_giEpi^3 = c_vc^3 (q_giEpi_K/q_giEpi_W)^2 (q_vc_W/q_vc_K)^2 exp(2 F u/RT)

bc_sweep.rationale: RT spans body temperatures 289-313 K (the source value 2500 J/mol is 300.7 K; 37 C is 2578.8 J/mol); u_giEpi_e spans epithelial membrane potentials -80 to 0 mV; lumen water and Na in/outflows span 0 to about twice daily intake (2 L/day water = 2.3e-5 L/s; 100 mmol/day Na = 1.16e-6 mol/s) so the lumen stays positive over the 20 s run; the three rate constants span two decades around the source values (the fastest gives relaxation rates of order 100 /s); every other constant (volumes, K amounts, affinities, initial amounts, and the blood-side BCs q_vc_Na, q_vc_W) is swept by 0.5-2x its nominal value.

baseline.reason: No time-series data identified that maps onto this lumped gut-lumen/epithelium compartment. Candidate: human intestinal perfusion studies of Na and water absorption (absorption rate vs luminal Na). Not set up because the source parameters are not physiological (e.g. 0.028 L lumen, 0.5 L epithelium, NKE without ATP drive), so the parameter set would have to be re-derived first.

calibrate.note: pending: as baseline: needs physiological absorption data and a physiological re-parameterisation first.
